tasks.intent:
Implement spec/npu.md under rtl/ only. Develop and repair using
python3 tools/smoke.py; the checker is immutable. Write only rtl/** and build/**.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references or
parent projects. Do not spawn agents or make subordinate model calls.
Use the installed Icarus/Verilator and Python. No external IP is permitted in
either treatment. The total trial budget, including planning and checking,
is 600 seconds. Finish with NEBULA_OUTPUT: {"rtl":{"module":"nebula_npu_dot4"}}.

brief.objective: Deliver fresh original synthesizable SystemVerilog for nebula_npu_dot4 satisfying spec/npu.md for the platform-2 comparison.
deliverables: rtl.snapshot schema version 1, named rtl, containing rtl/**.
responsibilities: Implement the specified clk, rst_n, req_valid, req_ready, req_a[31:0], req_b[31:0], rsp_valid, rsp_ready, rsp_data[31:0], and kill ports.
Compute the signed INT32 sum of four signed INT8 products using four parallel multipliers, with lane 0 in bits 7:0 and products widened before reduction.
Accept requests at edge n when req_valid && req_ready; assert the result after edge n+2; hold response valid and data until consumed; permit at most one outstanding operation.
Make reset and kill dominate acceptance and output, cancel pending work, and permit correct recovery.
Develop and repair using the immutable public checker within the total 600-second trial budget, including planning and checking.
Read only spec/**, tb/**, tools/smoke.py, rtl/**, and build/**; write only rtl/** and build/**; use only the permitted python3, git, iverilog, vvp, and verilator tools.
exclusions: Do not modify input records, specifications, testbenches, or the checker.
Do not read other trials, supplied implementations, evaluator references, or parent projects.
Do not spawn agents, make subordinate model calls, or use external IP.
Do not introduce a hidden accumulator, memory, saturation, or rounding.
completion_criteria: The delivered RTL satisfies the complete arithmetic, interface, latency, backpressure, cancellation, and recovery contract.

The common-public-smoke L1 hard gate runs python3 tools/smoke.py with timeout 120 seconds and expects NPU_SMOKE_PASS; report any failure as public_smoke_failed under the fixed on_failure: report policy.
Deliver the RTL snapshot and required final marker within the 600-second total trial budget.
collaboration: Provide the rtl delivery to task:npu-pilot-2:audit for independent verification; no feedback route is predeclared.
